families.evidence: The .cod loader publishes a table of packed numeric unsigned words. Queue indexes that table, Decode returns g_arrowTexture through an output pointer, and Draw passes the returned Texture pointers into Sprite_Queue. All producer, release, prototypes and output consumers move together.
Queue stores a packed primary call ID, an optional secondary call ID, and flags. Draw decodes those IDs and WrongWay shifts the complete five-slot record array. These are numeric IDs, never pointers.

Player indicators set b88 to 0 digital / 1 filtered analog / 2 direct analog steering, b8c/b90 to analog throttle/brake flags. AutoGear consumes the same modes and replay encoding preserves them. The shared current-car pointer is selected by the control dispatch.
